title: Enterprise Ask: Rapid Profiling and Implementation Sketch
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Summary: Sales and CS are sending a growing volume of high-touch enterprise feature requests that are not bugs. These requests vary widely in scope and engineering effort. We need a short, repeatable process that aggregates related asks, quickly profiles customer intent and success criteria, and produces a one-page implementation sketch (including rough effort bands) that can be reviewed by Solutions Eng and Eng leadership within 48 hours.

Goals:
- Reduce back-and-forth between CS and Eng during intake for top 15% revenue accounts.
- Produce consistent scoping artifacts that speed prioritization decisions (A/B: 48hr sketch vs current 7–14 day response).
- Surface technical unknowns early (data residency, model constraints, integrations) to reduce rework.

Outcomes expected:
- A 1-page standardized "Rapid Profile" template captured in Confluence/Drive.
- A lightweight rubric that maps profiles to three implementation bands (small: <2 wks, medium: 2–8 wks, large: >8 wks) and recommended owner (PM-led / Solutions Eng / EPIC).
- A demo workflow in the intake queue that auto-tags and groups similar asks for batch scoping.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Rapid Profile template exists and is populated for 12 recent enterprise asks; 2) For a sample of 20 incoming tickets, 75% are clustered into an existing profile within 48 hours; 3) Engineering and Solutions Eng sign off on the implementation sketch for at least 3 pilot customers; 4) Stakeholder checklist fields (data needs, security constraints, SLA expectations, 3rd-party integrations) are present in every profile.
proposed_solution:
Option A (Lean): Build a 6-field Rapid Profile form inside the intake tool + Slack notification to Solutions Eng. Use a lightweight human triage to populate template and assign band.
Option B (Assist): Add a simple NLP-assisted clustering that suggests similar past asks and pre-fills parts of the profile (title, dependency hints).
Recommendation: Start with Option A to ship immediate improvements; design Option B as a follow-on in the same project to accelerate throughput if triage becomes the bottleneck.
risks_tradeoffs:
- Risk: upfront false positives when clustering; mitigated by human review.
- Tradeoff: speed vs accuracy — 48hr sketches will be higher-level and may under-estimate hidden integration work. We will include a 'technical uncertainty' flag to trigger deeper discovery.
- Operational cost: initial manual effort from Solutions Eng may be required for ~4 weeks to stand up the rubric; budgeted in cycle allocation.
